operations.name: Search
operations.description: Get the organic results, ads and related searches Brave Search shows for a query

fields.description: How many result pages to collect, about 20 results each. Each page is one billed call.

options.description: Two-letter code of the language Brave Search is shown in. Empty uses English.
The country Brave Search is opened from. Brave takes the results region and the ads from it. Automatic uses the US.

operations.name: Search Images
operations.description: Find images that match a keyword, with links to the full-size image and the page it is on

fields.description: The most images to return. 0 returns all (about 200). Brave returns them on one page, billed as one call.

options.description: The country Brave Images is opened from. Brave takes the results region from it. Automatic uses the US.

operations.disabled: Brave blocks the image search (502 on every try, 2026-10-06)
